description: A depth-1 checkout of a docs/ branch that ADDS an AI review with no Reviewer Provenance section. With a full history this is PROV-002 and the run fails. With no base, Invoke-ReviewProvenanceCheck returns at its first line without listing a single candidate, and the machine half of gate 5 grades nothing while the verdict says OK. The review file is the point: the violation is present, detectable, and invisible.

commits.message: docs: add a review with no provenance

specs/001-thing/ai-code-review.md: APPROVE. No provenance section, no attestation - this file is exactly what
PROV-002 and PROV-005 exist to reject.
